exercises.instruction: What does the phrase mean? Look at the tense of the verb before olan.

items.explanation: -ecek: future. Gelecek olan: who will come.

options: a meeting that has already ended
a meeting that's going on now
items.explanation: -miş: already happened, the result is right there.
-mekte: the process is going on right now.

options: the person who will write the letter
the letter that the person will write
the person who wrote the letter
items.explanation: Olan describes the one who does the action: the person writes. Mektubu (the letter) is the object.

exercises.instruction: Sort the board by tense: will happen, happening now, already happened.

items.explanation: Look at the suffix before olan: -AcAk will happen, -mAktA happening, -mIş already happened.

exercises.instruction: Put the verb in the right tense. Olan is already in place.

items.text: Yarın ___ olan misafirler için yemek hazırladık.
items.translation: We cooked food for the guests who will come tomorrow.
items.say: Yarın gelecek olan misafirler için yemek hazırladık.
items.explanation: Yarın: future, so gelecek before olan. Gelen can't say “will come.”

items.translation: The train that will go to Istanbul departs at 15:30.
items.explanation: Git changes t to d before a vowel: gidecek.

items.text: Şu an peronda ___ olan yolcular var.
items.translation: There are passengers waiting on the platform right now.
items.say: Şu an peronda beklemekte olan yolcular var.
items.explanation: Şu an: right now. A process: -mekte olan.

items.text: Bu, ___ olan bir iş. Yarın devam edeceğiz.
items.translation: This is unfinished work. We'll continue tomorrow.
items.say: Bu, bitmemiş olan bir iş. Yarın devam edeceğiz.
items.explanation: The work will continue, so it isn't finished: negation -me- on the verb, bitmemiş.

exercises.instruction: Build the phrase. One word is extra.

items.translation: We cooked food for the guests who will come.
items.say: Gelecek olan misafirler için yemek hazırladık.
items.explanation: Tense only on the verb: gelecek olan, not olacak.

items.translation: The train that has already arrived from Konya is at platform two.
items.say: Konya'dan gelmiş olan tren ikinci peronda.
items.explanation: Already arrived: -miş olan.

items.translation: Remove those who have already come from the list.
items.explanation: There's no noun, so the ending -ları rides on olan.

exercises.instruction: The departure board at Ankara station. It's 14:00. Give each line the right tense: with a button, a finger, or keys 1–3.

items.explanation: 15:30 is still ahead. Future: -AcAk olan.
Already arrived, the result is right there: -mIş olan.
The process is going on this minute: -mAktA olan.
13:40 has already passed: -mIş olan.

items.prompt: 2. peronda ___ olan çalışmalar · work in progress
items.explanation: Happening now, official tone: -mAktA olan.
18:00 is ahead: -AcAk olan.

items.statement: After -mAktA you can drop olan: “devam etmekte çalışmalar.”
items.explanation: With -mAktA, olan is required: devam etmekte olan çalışmalar.

items.prompt: How do you say “those who won't come”?
items.explanation: Negation on the verb (gelmeyecek), the -lar ending on olan.

items.say: Yarın gelecek olan misafirler için yemek var.
items.explanation: The tense is already on the verb. Olan never changes.

items.text: Şu an kütüphanede kitap ___ olan öğrenciler var.
items.translation: There are students reading books in the library right now.
items.say: Şu an kütüphanede kitap okumakta olan öğrenciler var.
items.explanation: Şu an: a process right now, -makta olan.
After ö you need -müş: görmüş olan.
